system.description:
Waterworks is named in the Plumber lifepath but has no entry in the skill list; it is given here using the Plumbing entry.

The fine art of plumbing. Using this skill a character may design systems to convey water from one location to another. Typical plumbing in the middle ages was made of lead, wood and stone.

Obstacles: A well, Ob 1. Troughs or ducts, Ob 2. A pump, Ob 3. Plumbing, Ob 4. Hot and cold running water, Ob 5.

Skill Type: Artisan. Tools: Yes.

Root: Perception

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 288
